cases.name: Frances Kendra Lucero
cases.about:
Her mother Liezel Chan Lucero, who is now taking care of her children, said sometimes they ask if there is a way they can talk to their mother.

Her Go Fund Me said: "Frances was a beautiful Mother, daughter, sister, and friend who touched countless lives of those around her. She sadly leaves behind her Mother, Father, little brother, little sister and her two babies.

Frances dedicated her life to her children and always spread the love she had to share. She was the most genuine, thoughtful, loyal and ambitious woman we've all been blessed to know. Frances was that friend that would help you celebrate good times and provide nothing but support during the bad times."
cases.narrative: After they argued in the driveway of their home he shot her several times in front of their 3-year-old and 4-year-old as she tried to run away.
